game_title: Accumulator Pump – Torchlit Cave Mouth Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round, giant bats strike the lantern post, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the total value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth: keep the total meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: total drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while total > 0.
